title: The Harmonious household of three generations
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：harmonious　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 harmonious 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the counsellor wrote of ① a harmonious household of three generations in the journal, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② more harmonious than the one named there the year before. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the counsellor, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the harmonious ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most harmonious household of three generations anybody in the garden had ever seen, or so the journal for June 1953 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too harmonious to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the harmonious ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a harmonious mixture of colours, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as harmonious as the mixture of colours they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was harmonious or not, and he said so.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something harmonious, and nothing besides. The listener from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite harmonious; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the harmonious ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969, year after year, she wrote of another harmonious household of three generations in the same journal, and the work, which took two evenings, seemed ⑨ more harmonious than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most harmonious mixture of colours in the whole garden, she said in 1971, was the one she could never quite name; the harmonious ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 和谐（前置定语 a harmonious household of three generations：1959 年谈心人在心记里记下的那件和谐的一家）
B. adj. 和谐／和睦（比较级 more harmonious than：文中两处，一处比三代同堂的一家，一处比预想）
C. adj. 和谐／和睦（最高级 the most harmonious：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 和谐（表语 too harmonious to do：母亲觉得它太和谐，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 和睦（前置定语 a harmonious mixture of colours：叔叔把整件事称作一桩和睦的配色）
F. adj. 和睦（同级比较 as harmonious as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩协调的配色相比）
G. adj. 和睦（后置定语 something harmonious：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 和睦（受程度副词修饰 quite harmonious：那位倾听者的评价）

items.q: a harmonious household of three generations
the most harmonious household of three generations anybody
The most harmonious mixture of colours in

answers.why: harmonious 意为“和谐”，1959 年谈心人在心记里记下的是“一件和谐的一家”，此处作前置定语 a harmonious household of three generations。
harmonious 意为“和谐”，此处用比较级 more harmonious than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
harmonious 意为“和谐”，心记上 六月 那行字说它是小园里最和谐的一件，故用最高级 the most harmonious household of three generations。
harmonious 意为“和谐”，母亲认为这件东西“太和谐了，谁也用不上”，too harmonious to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
harmonious 意为“和睦”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩和睦的配色”，此处作前置定语 a harmonious mixture of colours。
harmonious 意为“和睦”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩协调的配色一样和睦”，同级比较用 as harmonious as。
harmonious 意为“和睦”，心记上那半行字要的是“和睦的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something harmonious。
harmonious 意为“和睦”，邻小园来的那位倾听者认为这套计划“相当和睦”，quite 修饰原级 harmonious。
harmonious 意为“和睦”，1969 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要和睦”，故用比较级 more harmonious than。
harmonious 意为“和睦”，母亲 1971 年说的是“整个小园里最和睦的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most harmonious mixture of colours。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，谈心人在心记里记下了一件和谐的一家。（a harmonious household of three generations）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更和谐。（more harmonious than …）
母亲觉得它太和谐，谁也用不上。（too harmonious to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩和睦的配色。（a harmonious mixture of colours）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩协调的配色一样和睦。（as harmonious as …）
到了 1966 年，心记上只剩半行字：要的是一件和睦的东西。（something harmonious）
answers: In 1959 the counsellor wrote of a harmonious household of three generations in the journal.
Everybody said it was more harmonious than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too harmonious to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a harmonious mixture of colours.
He said nobody would call it as harmonious as the mixture of colours they had once had.
By 1966 the journal asked for nothing but something harmonious.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 harmonious 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the counsellor wrote of a harmonious household of three generations in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most harmonious household of three generations in the garden, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too harmonious to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a harmonious mixture of colours, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next garden called the plan quite harmonious, and everybody laughed.
The harmonious ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
